olivia_csm: Quick ask  can we produce a 1-page customer primer: 'Launch Pocket Guide' for priming + renewal-risk signals? need checklist + tiny config + escalation triggers.
kevin_eng: yep. keep it 6 bullets + one short yaml snippet + 3 alert rules.
maria_cs: customers want one copy-paste line to approve priming. include a post-priming survey template.
sam_sre: add operational caveats: streaming boosts UX but increases concurrent connections; fallback to non-streaming or smaller model. recommend warm_pool=2 for first 2 hours.
kevin_eng: snippet for infra to copy: ```yaml
priming: {enabled: true, prefill: 20, warm_pool: 2}
serving: {batch: {max_requests: 6}, streaming: true, cache_ttl_seconds: 600}
```
maria_cs: customer consent line: "Please approve 30 minutes for a short priming run to warm instances and cache common prefixes."
kevin_eng: alert triggers to monitor (suggested): 1) errors >3x baseline for 10m -> page eng-oncall; 2) golden prompt success rate drop >=30% over 1h -> notify AM + open ticket; 3) avg latency >=2x baseline for 15m -> run fallback and page oncall.
sam_sre: troubleshooting order (copyable): 1) confirm model pin + revert if needed 2) verify warm_pool and prefill status 3) reduce batch.max_requests to lower tail latency 4) toggle streaming=false if connection errors 5) route small % to fallback model.
maria_cs: post-priming email template: Subject: "Priming complete  quick check" Body bullets: "1) Outputs ok? (Y/N) 2) Avg latency (ms) 3) Any errors/timeouts?"
olivia_csm: great  i'll format the one-pager and post for review. tagging @kevin_eng @sam_sre.
opsbot: Created internal template -> /ops/templates/launch-pocket-guide.yaml :white_check_mark:
